fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) trades at PER of 19.0x, the second-lowest among peers, but recent four-quarter revenue growth rate of 49.0% exceeds Hewlett Packard Enterprise's 26.6%, demonstrating superior growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Infrastructure Solutions Group's fiscal Q2 2027 revenue increased 89% year-over-year to $31.8 billion, with AI servers alone recording $16.4 billion, and unshipped AI orders reaching record high of $95 billion.
fields.summary_ko.2: Dell's fiscal Q3 2027 guidance projects revenue of $49 billion at midpoint, exceeding fiscal Q2 2027's $47.0 billion, and full-year guidance was also raised to $192 billion.
